messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT: Elevated latency + 5xx spike observed for dedicated pool eu-west-1-pool-42. Impacting ~18 tenants. Auto-escalation triggered, paging on-call. metric:5xx_rate > 5% over 5m.
ben-oncall: I’m on it — picking up the page. Can someone grab customer impact list?
alice-ng: looking now, pulling tenant list from monitoring. Preliminary: 3 high-traffic customers (cust-A, cust-B, cust-C) showing tail latency > 2s for completions >1024 tokens.
carl-sre: any recent deploys to that pool? checking infra logs...
dana-platform: no deploys in the last 30m. Autoscale events spiked — lot of scale attempts hitting gating, saw OOM on a subset of nodes.
eve-support: opening tickets for cust-A/B/C now so support can proactively message them. Ticket IDs: SUP-1123, SUP-1124, SUP-1125.
ben-oncall: mitigation plan proposal: (1) enable emergency autoscale (raise hard max for pool), (2) temporarily enable burst_capacity on pool-42, (3) apply soft per-tenant qps caps to free headroom, (4) disable nonessential background features for batch-completions (prefetch/long-stream). Agree?
alice-ng: agree. Suggest order: apply qps caps first (quick rollbackable), then burst toggle, then autoscale if needed. Also prepare fallback routing to hosted small-model variant for cust-C (low-latency fallback).
carl-sre: executing qps caps now. Command: ```rictl tenants update --scope pool-42 --cap qps=20 --mode soft --ttl 15m```
incident-bot: ACTION LOGGED: qps caps command issued by carl-sre.
dana-platform: toggling burst capacity: ```rictl pools update --id pool-42 --burst true --burst-mode=token-bucket --burst-tokens=2000``` — applying, will take ~30s to propagate.
ben-oncall: enabling emergency autoscale if burst doesn't reduce errors. Command staged: ```rictl pools autoscale set --id pool-42 --policy emergency --max-nodes 60 --grace 120s```
eve-support: messages sent to cust-A/B/C with mitigations and expected timeline ~20-30m. cust-A replied they’ll throttle on their side for urgent jobs.
incident-bot: POOL EVENT: burst enabled on pool-42 (propagation complete).
carl-sre: seeing immediate drop in queue latency; 5xxs falling but not to baseline yet. Some nodes still seeing memory pressure.
ben-oncall: triggering node-level mitigation: cordon/replace unhealthy nodes. ```k8sctl drain node gpu-node-17 && k8sctl create node-replacement --flavor g5```. Doing one at a time.
dana-platform: while nodes recycle, turning on traffic shaping to smooth bursts: applied token-bucket at gateway with rps-limit 500 and burst 200 for pool-42 gateway.
alice-ng: cust-C switched ~12% traffic to hosted small-model fallback automatically via route rule. That helped tail latencies for them.
fred-sales: FYI cust-B’s SRE on call pinged me, they want a short heads-up email. Eve, can you include an ETA in the update?
eve-support: yes, sending update now — ETA 25m.
carl-sre: 5xx rate at 1.1% now, latency trending toward baseline. Still monitoring for memory exceptions on a couple of pods.
not-a-user: (bot suppression placeholder)
ben-oncall: ok good progress. Plan for next 30m: keep burst on, keep soft qps caps, let autoscale remain in emergency but don't increase max unless we see sustained queue depth. Postmortem owner: alice-ng.
alice-ng: taking postmortem. Will collect logs, scale traces, and a timeline. Requesting any config diffs or manual toggles recorded in this thread be pasted into the incident doc.
dana-platform: recording actions to incident timeline: qps caps applied, burst=true, emergency-autoscale staged, node replacements started, gateway shaping applied, fallback routing for cust-C.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity reduced to P2. 5xx below threshold. continued monitoring for 2h.
eve-support: support will keep cust tickets updated and coordinate any refunds/credits if needed.
fred-sales: thanks team — let me know if we need an account-level follow-up with cust-B tomorrow.
ben-oncall: closing handoff to daytime oncall in 40m. I'll annotate runbook steps I took. If anything regresses, page on-call as usual.
alice-ng: thanks — grabbing logs and will start the postmortem doc. Leaving notes: do not forget to evaluate burst token sizing and autoscale gating thresholds.
carl-sre: marking nodes healthy, 0 pods in OOM since replacements.
dana-platform: scheduling a follow-up change to test reduced autoscale gating in staging to avoid repeat.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (monitoring): last recorded 5xx spike cleared. Close after 2h stable window.
ben-oncall: ending thread, moving details to /incidents/1749501234-postmortem-draft in docs. Thanks all :thumbsup:
